reviews.title: Goods and bads
reviews.text:
Goods:
-They have this one week VIP sale for about five dollars so you can really fill it out and see what you’re working with in your area.
It’s pretty useful and nice that they have it on a advanced search to actually see people that are about
Bads:
-you’ll randomly get alike from someone, but then the account will be deleted
-you can’t see who liked you but that’s how this works with most dating apps, except this one is a lot more dead than the other ones and you’ll usually see the same account
-the app is flooded with a variety of people but a lot of times it’s just old accounts that haven’t been deleted or just sitting there. Collecting dust. Now I understand that they probably want to protect people from spam accounts and I respect that. But not being able to delete your account makes it to where it’s just random dead accounts, collecting likes and messages.
-you are limited on likes even if you have VIP and etc. which I find to be pretty dumb in my opinion because if I’m paying money to actually be able to DM people and like people, I should be able to do it as many times as I want to. After all, you are charging me money to be on your website to talk to people that’s kind of the whole point.
-I understand that you can’t just keep having people really close if they’re far away but there’s no way that I’m in one area and I’m getting recommended to somebody who’s about 20 through 30 miles away from me that doesn’t really make any sense when I put it on about a 10 to 5 mi

They do regular miss curvy competitions, with the top women on there getting thousands of votes. Men can also spend hundreds of real money to increase their votes, it’s madness! 

There is a moments section, which is all the latest photos people have posted. You can then like and comment like Instagram in a way. It really brings out the worst in men and women. You have attention seeking women treating it like a social media app (often their posts go back years), and men simping and spending real money. 

If the app was stripped back to basics, it could be very good. They need to remove all the social media style rubbish. There are genuine women on there, it’s just harder to find them.

reviews.title: Fake dating app
reviews.text: My experience with WooPlus has been disappointing. The app appears to rely heavily on automated or inactive profiles, as most conversations never develop beyond an initial “hi.” In the rare cases where someone responds, they often disappear immediately and never reply again. Based on my experience, it feels as though a large percentage of the profiles may not belong to active, genuine users. I would encourage WooPlus to improve profile verification, reduce suspected bot activity, and create a more reliable environment for meaningful conversations.

Tell me why most of the men that I find attractive just want to have sex and then fat shame. Because even though this is a plus size app, there are men on here that are fat shaming because you’re not interested in them.

reviews.title: Filled with fake people and bot accounts
reviews.text: The app is pretty good in the sense that it gives you quick and seamless matches. I love the implementation of “Moments” that let you post photos of yourself for people to like and leave comments. However there’s a bug stemming issue that’s plagued the app ever since I got it and that’s the bot accounts. Way too many times have I matched or gotten comments from people that are either promoting their telegram scamming accounts or just straight not the people they claim to be in their photos. 9 times outta 10 of their photos are still “under review” they’re not a real person. I’m not sure if the people behind this app are unaware or just purposely implemented bots for their numbers and personal gain. Either way it’s disgusting and needs to be addressed immediately.

reviews.title: Gaslighting Notifications
reviews.text: As if it weren’t already annoying enough to be held behind so many walls as a free user, this app gaslights you into thinking you have notifications in hopes of making you log on and doomscroll. Every day I think I have a real notification and it’s all because of this stupid beauty pageant they have that you CAN NOT unsubscribe to. So if you’re here for dating, SORRY, but it’s actually a massive popularity test. They also used to have a pretty nice secret admirer ice breaker feature in the app that allowed you to chat with people before seeing their faces which was actually really cool and pretty much the only way I ever secured matches without having to pay in, but they ruined it and redesigned it to be a game that barely even works half the time. This app is unjustly expensive if you’d like even the cheapest tier available, honestly it’s trash. You’re better off on tinder, and that’s really sad. Don’t use this app.
